errata.orig:
Actions of the sender:

   The server constructs an appropriate certificate chain and conveys it
   to the client in the Certificate message.  If the client has used a
   Supported Elliptic Curves Extension, the public key in the server's
   certificate MUST respect the client's choice of elliptic curves.  A
   server that cannot satisfy this requirement MUST NOT choose an ECC
   cipher suite in its ServerHello message.)
errata.correct:
Actions of the sender:

   The server constructs an appropriate certificate chain and conveys it
   to the client in the Certificate message.  If the client has used a
   Supported Elliptic Curves Extension, the public key in the server's
   certificate MUST respect the client's choice of elliptic curves.  A
   server that cannot satisfy this requirement MUST NOT choose an ECC
   cipher suite in its ServerHello message.
errata.notes: This removes the spurious closing parenthesis of the last sentence of the "Actions of the sender" paragraph.

errata.orig: namedCurve: Specifies a recommended set of elliptic curve domain
errata.correct: namedcurve: Specifies a recommended set of elliptic curve domain
errata.notes: This fixes mismatched names of the variable "namedcurve" in the "Structure of this message" paragraph.

errata.orig:
All RSA signatures must be generated and verified according to
   Section 7.2 of [RFC8017].
errata.correct:
All RSA signatures must be generated and verified according to
   Section 8.2 of [RFC8017].
errata.notes: Section 7.2 of RFC 8017 describes the RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5 encryption scheme. Section 8.2 of RFC 8017 describes the RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 signature scheme. The original text contradicts the natural expectation and is probably wrong. If it was intended, there should have been a thorough explanation (like in the well-known case of IKEv1 using the encryption scheme for signing).

errata.orig:
IANA has assigned two values in the "TLS SignatureAlgorithm" registry
   for ed25519 (7) and ed448 (8) with this document as reference.  This
   keeps compatibility with TLS 1.3.
errata.correct:
IANA has assigned two values in the "TLS SignatureAlgorithm" registry
   for ed25519 (7) and ed448 (8) with DTLS-OK set to "Y" and this document
   as reference.  This keeps compatibility with TLS 1.3.
errata.notes: IANA had consulted with Yoav, one of the authors (and a TLS registry expert), who explicitly told them to use DTLS-OK of "Y", but this clarification was not reflected in the final RFC.  This also matches the text in the subsequent paragraph.
the ServerKeyExchange for ECDH_RSA and ECDH_anon should be specified for tls version 1.2.
